text: HELLO, MY NAME IS [color=b45252]ISAAC[/color]. IT'S NICE TO MEET YOU.
I'M HONESTLY NOT SURE WHY YOU GOT A JOB HERE.
THERE'S LIKE A [color=b45252]90% CHANCE[/color] THAT YOU'LL DIE...
[color=b45252]DEFUSING BOMBS[/color] IS VERY DANGEROUS WORK.
ANYWAY, HERE YOU ARE, AND I'M [color=b45252]TEACHING YOU[/color].
WHEN YOU SEE A BOMB, CLICK THE WIRES TO CUT 'EM.
TO ORGANIZE YOUR THOUGHTS, YOU CAN...
DRAG THOSE NUMBERS AROUND TO THE RIGHT...
OR TYPE IN THE NOTES.
DRAG THOSE NUMBERS AROUND TO THE RIGHT.
GO AHEAD AND TRY IT OUT.
WE GET [color=b45252]A WHOLE BUNCH[/color] OF BOMBS HERE EVERY DAY.
EACH [color=b45252]SHOULD[/color] HAVE INSTRUCTIONS LIKE THESE ONES.

defuse.hint: CUTTING A WIRE "JUST BEFORE" ANOTHER ONE MEANS THAT IT MUST COME DIRECTLY BEFORE IT IN THE SEQUENCE.

text: THESE ARE PRETTY STRAIGHTFORWARD.
HOWEVER, OUR INTERN [color=b45252]MESSED UP[/color] THE OTHER ONES.
EACH OF THEM HAS [color=b45252]EXACTLY ONE[/color] RULE WHICH IS WRONG.
AFTER YOU TAKE IT OUT, THERE'S [color=b45252]ONE SOLUTION[/color].
IF THERE'S MORE THAN ONE, YOU'RE PROBABLY WRONG.
YOU CAN CLICK ON A RULE TO MARK IT AS WRONG.
REMEMBER, ONLY ONE RULE IS WRONG.
THIS OFTEN LEADS TO SOME KIND OF [color=b45252]CONTRADICTION[/color].
TRY THIS ONE OUT.

defuse.hint: THE FIRST TWO RULES CONTRADICT EACH OTHER, SO ONE OF THEM MUST BE WRONG. THEREFORE, BOTH OF THE OTHER RULES ARE DEFINITELY TRUE.

text: NOW SEE IF YOU CAN GET THIS ONE.
I THINK YOU'RE READY FOR THE REAL DEAL.
GOOD LUCK AND FAREWELL.
